title: Google Maps adds AI tools for trip planning and appointments
excerpt: Google Maps has introduced new artificial intelligence features to help users create travel itineraries and find available appointments.
body_html:
Google has rolled out new artificial intelligence-powered capabilities for Google Maps. The updated platform now enables users to generate comprehensive travel itineraries directly through the application.

In addition to travel planning, the new tools are designed to assist individuals in finding and securing available appointments. These updates aim to enhance the functionality of the mapping service by integrating advanced digital assistance.
